description:
[Wicked Registry] Metadata and usage for a Registry API key (wr_...): label, created time, call counts. Pass api_key, or set REGISTRY_API_KEY.

Use when you want a Registry API key's label, creation time and usage counts. Not for creating or revoking a key.

Behavior: read-only.

api_key.description: Registry API key to inspect. Overrides REGISTRY_API_KEY.

name: registry_key_info
